newsitem.title: LATVIA: OTC TRADE 515,139 LATS IN SECOND WEEK OF MAY.
newsitem.headline: OTC TRADE 515,139 LATS IN SECOND WEEK OF MAY.

text.p: The over-the-counter trade in second the week of May came to 515,139 lats against the official market's turnover of 369,268 lats, the Latvian bourse said on Friday.
Staburadze confectionery registered the biggest volume on the free market, turning over 294,265 lats, followed by Valmiera Glassfibre, a secondary list stock, at 103,265 lats.
Unibanka saw OTC trade of 53,431 lats and was the most traded on the official market at 88,796 lats.
Kaija fish cannery and Daugavpils chain saw 67,986 lats and 63,269 lats of shares traded respectively on the official market during the second week of May.
